subject: Immediate maintenance: short-notice memory safeguard for streaming endpoints
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Eli Sanchez <eli.sanchez@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T01:12:00-07:00
Subject: Immediate maintenance: short-notice memory safeguard for streaming endpoints

Eli —

We just discovered a memory-growth condition affecting long-lived streaming sessions on our streaming inference route (models served with continuous KV cache > 12k tokens). To prevent customer-facing OOMs we need to deploy a short, targeted memory-safeguard patch across a subset of nodes.

Planned window (short notice):
- Start: 2027-04-25 01:30 PDT
- Duration: 15–25 minutes (rolling across nodes; individual node restarts will be ~2–3 minutes)

Impact:
- Brief 2–3 minute interruption for active streaming sessions on affected nodes. Short-lived requests (non-streaming) are expected to continue with no change.
- No model weights or user data will be modified; this is a runtime change to the streaming process.

Action requested:
- If you're running scheduled long-running evaluations or continuous streaming tests that start during this window, please pause them until 02:00 PDT.
- If you have mission-critical runs that cannot be paused, reply and we'll coordinate immediate protections for your traffic.

Why this is urgent: we observed degraded node-level memory that may cause abrupt process restarts if left unpatched. The patch adds a lightweight guardrail to proactively bound KV cache memory usage, with a conservative eviction threshold.

Attachments: safeguard_patch.diff.txt (patch), deploy-plan-brief.txt
Status link: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/20270425

I'll post a confirmation when the rollout completes. Reach me directly on Slack #incident or +1 (415) 555-0132.

Thanks,
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Eli Sanchez <eli.sanchez@acme-analytics.com>

Subject: Re: Immediate maintenance: short-notice memory safeguard for streaming endpoints

Thanks Diego — appreciated the heads up. We'll pause our scheduled continuous evaluation job that was due to start at 01:40 PDT and hold off any long streaming runs until you confirm completion.

Please alert us if the window grows beyond 02:00 PDT; otherwise we expect to resume tests once you confirm.

—Eli

Subject: Re: Immediate maintenance: short-notice memory safeguard for streaming endpoints (deploy update)

Deploy update — starting rolling deploy now (01:35 PDT). Sequence:
- Canary: 2 nodes (1:35–1:38) — monitoring memory and QPS
- Batch: additional groups of 3 nodes every ~4 minutes

Rollback criteria:
- Any node with >3% error increase for >30s
- Unexpected latency spikes >100ms 90th

Current status: canary healthy after 2 minutes; no regressions observed. Will post progress after each batch. Ops on-call is standing by to roll back a group if needed.

Logs attached: deploy-log-20270425.txt

-Rishi

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T01:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Immediate maintenance: short-notice memory safeguard for streaming endpoints — completed

Eli —

Update: the rolling safeguard deploy completed at 01:48 PDT. Impact was within the expected brief interruptions; we did one targeted rollback of a single group when latency briefly increased and re-deployed a tuned variant (no customer-facing errors).

Post-deploy notes:
- Root-cause: unbounded KV cache growth for long-lived streaming sessions under a specific token-growth pattern. Fix introduces conservative eviction and a telemetry guard.
- Follow-up: we'll publish a short postmortem and a recommended config patch for long-running customers within 48 hours.

Actions for Acme:
- You can resume paused evaluations now.
- If you see any anomalies, file a ticket or ping me directly; we'll prioritize an investigation.

We've attached the deploy logs and the exact patch we applied. As this was short-notice, I'll also arrange a goodwill credit on usage for the window — expect a note from billing this week.

Postmortem (draft): https://drive.google.com/postmortem/1A2B3C
Public status: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/20270425

Sorry for the disruption and thank you for the quick coordination.

Diego
Diego Fernandez
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
